results.question: Be honest with me, what are his biggest weaknesses? Why would someone NOT hire him?
results.answer: Sreehari’s primary limitation is the relatively short length of his professional experience—about two years combined across AI internships and freelance work. However, in that time he achieved concrete results such as cutting YOLO inference latency by 71 % (from 14 ms to 4 ms) and delivering a LiDAR‑camera safety system with 92 % detection accuracy in field validation. He is eager to discuss any concerns directly, so reaching out by email or WhatsApp via the contact buttons below is recommended.
